d: Deep espresso-brown hair is extremely long, wavy, and voluminous, flowing past the waist with thick braids and adorned with white flowers and green leaves. The large, round eyes are a muted olive green with a neutral, vacant expression, set upon a youthful face with a childlike maturity. The build is slender and small, dressed in a cream-colored halter-neck dress featuring olive-green floral patterns, a fringed hem, and a matching shawl draped over the back. Accessories include multiple beaded necklaces, a shell-decorated waist belt, a floral crown, and a white circular marking on the right shoulder.
